product_overview: A personal portfolio website designed to showcase an individual's skills, projects, work experience, publications, and provide contact functionality with advanced animations and responsive design.
core_goals: Showcase professional skills, projects, and experiences clearly and attractively.
Provide an engaging and interactive user experience with advanced animations and smooth navigation.
Enable easy contact through integrated forms and social media links.
Support responsive design for accessibility on various devices.
Maintain high performance and optimized loading times to enhance user experience.
key_features: Hero Section with animated typing effect and call-to-action buttons to engage visitors immediately.
About Me Section with animated feature cards and skill badges for personal introduction.
Skills Section supporting interactive skill displays with hovering effects and category filtering.
Projects Section showcasing portfolio projects with filtering options and detailed project views.
Experience Section presenting work history and internships in a timeline format including certifications.
Publications Section displaying research publications with optimized images for quality and performance.
Contact Section including a functional contact form with email integration and convenient social media links.
Responsive navigation components including mobile-friendly menus and smooth scrolling between sections.
Reusable UI components including loaders, buttons, custom cursors, and error boundaries to ensure consistency and reliability.
Advanced animations implemented using Framer Motion and GSAP for dynamic visuals.
Backend API using Node.js and Express to handle contact form submissions and email functionalities.
Performance monitoring utilities integrated to track and optimize site performance.
user_flow_summary: User lands on the Hero Section with animated greeting and clear call-to-actions.
User scrolls to About Me Section to learn background and skills, enhanced with animations.
User explores Skills Section to filter and view interactive skill badges.
User browses Projects Section, filtering projects by category and viewing detailed project pages.
User reviews Experience Section timeline for professional history and certifications.
User views Publications Section to see research outputs with optimized images.
User navigates to Contact Section to fill out the contact form or use provided social media links.
User experiences smooth navigation via responsive header and mobile menu, with seamless scrolling.
All interactions are enhanced with animations and consistent UI components ensuring smooth, engaging flow.
validation_criteria: All main sections (Hero, About Me, Skills, Projects, Experience, Publications, Contact) are accessible and function correctly on desktop and mobile devices.
Animations function smoothly without performance degradation or visual glitches.
Project filtering and detail views respond correctly to user interactions.
Contact form submits data correctly, triggering backend email functionality and providing user feedback.
Navigation works responsively, with mobile menu toggling and smooth scroll behavior.
Performance metrics meet predefined benchmarks for loading times and interaction responsiveness.
Error boundaries catch and handle UI errors gracefully without breaking the user experience.
All implemented features match the described requirements and UI designs, verified through testing.
